sloka: मत्तोऽयमिति मा मंस्था यद्यभीतोऽसि संयुगे ।मदोऽयं सम्प्रहारेऽस्मिन्वीरपानं समर्थ्यताम् ॥४-११-३८॥।।
transliteration: matto'yamiti mā maṁsthā yadyabhīto'si saṁyuge ।mado'yaṁ samprahāre'sminvīrapānaṁ samarthyatām ॥4-11-38॥।।

translations.english: 'Do not consider me drunken. This drink will serve as a warrior's drink in the combat. Be ready, if you are not afraid of a combat.'
